title: James Davolos on the MicroCapClub: A Deep Dive on Exchanges (October 2026)
gist: Horizon Kinetics' James Davolos explains on the MicroCapClub why exchanges have outperformed local markets over 20 years, why derivatives are their strongest moat, and why inflation and volatility benefit them; only the page summary and disclosures are available.

insights.claim: James Davolos argues exchanges have outperformed their local equity markets over the past 20 years.
insights.speaker: Horizon Kinetics
insights.so_what: Exchanges are presented as a persistent outperforming equity niche, though the page gives no figures.
insights.locator: why exchanges have outperformed their local markets over the past 20 years

insights.claim: Davolos calls derivatives the strongest moat in the exchange industry.
insights.speaker: Horizon Kinetics
insights.so_what: Derivatives franchises, which are hard to replicate through clearing and liquidity network effects, are the quality filter for exchange stocks.
insights.locator: why derivatives are the strongest moat in the industry

insights.claim: Davolos contends inflation and volatility can benefit exchanges.
insights.speaker: Horizon Kinetics
insights.so_what: Exchanges may serve as an inflation and volatility hedge within equities.
insights.locator: why inflation and volatility can benefit exchanges

insights.claim: Horizon Kinetics discloses that its employee Eric Sites sits on the board of Miami International Holdings (MIAX) and that MIAX and Texas Pacific Land are holdings in client accounts and funds.
insights.speaker: Horizon Kinetics
insights.so_what: The firm has direct exposure to an exchange operator it discusses, which is a conflict to factor into its views.
insights.locator: Peter Doyle is a member of the Board of Directors
